reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a 'to go' sachet fixes a problem I don't have. At $31k a year I'm not paying $30 for something I already have in the cabinet.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and a pill bottle costs less per day. Why pay more for individual sachets I don't need to carry?
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real problem I have, like sleeping badly when I travel, plus a price closer to what my bottle costs.
